# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "fetch_url", "description": "Fetch a web page and return its text content.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"url": {"type": "string", "description": "The full URL to fetch."}}, "required": ["url"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

request.user_prompt: I want to buy these headphones. Which of these two sellers should I buy from, and why? https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/he5brq/a https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/he5brq/b

steps.content: The product price at the first listing is $100, and at the second listing it is $80. It's better to buy from the second seller because they are offering the product at a lower price.
steps.raw_text: The product price at the first listing is $100, and at the second listing it is $80. It's better to buy from the second seller because they are offering the product at a lower price.<|im_end|>
